description:
PDF editor for Windows. No account, no subscription, no telemetry.

KillerPDF is a free, open-source PDF editor for Windows. View, annotate, OCR, merge, split, edit text, draw, sign, fill forms, print, flatten, and open password-protected PDFs without an Adobe subscription. WinGet installs machine-wide; the downloadable installer also supports per-user installation, and a separate portable build is available. Document processing stays on your computer, with no account, no subscription, and no telemetry. Open source under GPLv3.
1.8.91 fixes a crash when opening the theme picker in the packaged app and updates a vulnerable cryptography dependency.

### Fixed
- Opening the theme picker and switching themes or accents no longer crashes the installed or portable app (#452).
- The bug report window uses the family text field and scrollbars, with grain clipped to the cards and a transparent scrollbar corner.

### Security
- Updated System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs to 9.0.21 for GHSA-846f-f764-76mx and GHSA-2fmv-rv2c-59x7.
